t-vp-panel._note: Inset panel on a portal card - the dashboard's chart well (651:13582 light / 651:10945 dark). Vendor Portal only. The Flow 15 dark frames use their own tint ramp rather than the global dark tints — none of these dark values matches the token the light frame binds, so mapping them onto action-tint / info-tint / warn-tint / error-tint would be visibly wrong in dark. Light values are the global ones, so a single utility serves both themes. Do not use outside (vendor).
